chat_messages.text: Summarize why reranking helped precision in a mixed-provider archive when the team wanted more reliable answers but kept the same model.

Why reranking improved search precision: the embedding stage retrieved broadly relevant chunks, but a lightweight reranker pushed the exact troubleshooting passages above tangential notes. In practice that reduced hallucinations without using a larger model because the final prompt contained fewer misleading near-matches. It also worked better across mixed ChatGPT, Claude, and AI Studio exports where the same concept was phrased differently.
